title: FinTFM: a tabular foundation model for corporate credit risk, pretrained only on synthetic data
description:
An in-context tabular classifier for corporate credit risk, pretrained only on synthetic data and never on a real table. Prediction is a single forward pass with the user's table supplied as context: by default there are no gradient steps at fit time and no per-dataset tuning, and fine-tuning is opt-in.

The repository is built around a numbered measurement log and a claims ledger that record retractions and superseded results as prominently as confirmations. On TabArena-Lite (one fold, all 51 datasets, none excluded), FinTFM with a trained linear readout scores 903 Elo, 107th of 110 methods; the zero-shot model, submitted to TabArena on 27 binary datasets, placed 94th of 95. On real corporate-default panels its discrimination loses to gradient boosting (0.20 against 0.40 mean average precision for untuned CatBoost on V4FinBench), and it is below logistic regression on four further credit datasets. Calibration was among the best measured for an earlier architecture; it is not claimed for the published checkpoint.

Code and the published binary checkpoint are Apache-2.0. From mid-November 2026 the project is no longer actively supported.
